items.source: In addition to CrudRepository, there are PagingAndSortingRepository and ListPagingAndSortingRepository which add additional methods to ease paginated access to entities:
items.translation: 除了 CrudRepository 之外，还有 PagingAndSortingRepository 和 ListPagingAndSortingRepository，它们添加了额外方法以简化对实体的分页访问：

items.source: The CrudRepository and ListCrudRepository interfaces provide sophisticated CRUD functionality for the entity class that is being managed.
items.translation: `CrudRepository` 和 `ListCrudRepository` 接口为被管理的实体类提供了复杂的 CRUD 功能。

items.source: The methods declared in this interface are commonly referred to as CRUD methods. ListCrudRepository offers equivalent methods, but they return List where the CrudRepository methods return an Iterable.
items.translation: 本接口中声明的方法通常被称为 CRUD 方法。 ListCrudRepository 提供了等效的方法，但它们返回的是 List，而 CrudRepository 中的方法则返回 Iterable。

items.source: You can annotate your query method with @Query to provide a custom query if a property named Id doesn’t refer to the identifier. Following that path can easily lead to confusion and is discouraged as you will quickly hit type limits if the ID type and the type of your Id property deviate.
items.translation: 您可以使用 @Query 注解为查询方法提供自定义查询，前提是名为 Id 的属性不指向标识符。 遵循此路径很容易导致混淆，且不被推荐，因为如果 ID 类型与您 Id 属性的类型存在偏差，您很快就会遇到类型限制。

items.source: ListPagingAndSortingRepository offers equivalent methods, but returns a List where the PagingAndSortingRepository methods return an Iterable.
items.translation: ListPagingAndSortingRepository 提供了等效的方法，但其返回类型为 List，而 PagingAndSortingRepository 方法返回的是 Iterable。

items.source: Note: Properties of Persistable will get detected and persisted if you use AccessType.PROPERTY. To avoid that, use @Transient.
items.translation: 注意：如果您使用 AccessType.PROPERTY，Persistable 的属性将被检测并持久化。为避免这种情况，请使用 @Transient。

items.source: If a property annotated with @Version is present and null, or in case of a version property of primitive type 0 the entity is considered new. If the version property is present but has a different value, the entity is considered to not be new. If no version property is present Spring Data falls back to inspection of the identifier property.
items.translation: 如果存在一个带有 @Version 注解的属性，且其值为 null；或者在版本属性为基本类型且值为 0 的情况下，该实体被视为新实体。 如果版本属性存在但具有不同的值，则该实体不被视为新实体。 如果没有版本属性存在，Spring Data 将回退到检查标识符属性。

items.source: If an entity implements Persistable, Spring Data delegates the new detection to the isNew(…) method of the entity. See the Javadoc for details.
items.translation: 如果实体实现了Persistable，Spring Data 会将新对象的检测委托给实体的isNew(…)方法。有关详细信息，请参阅Javadoc。

items.source: The repository interface implies a few reserved methods like findById(ID identifier) that target the domain type identifier property regardless of its property name. Read more about this in “Defining Query Methods”.
items.translation: 仓库接口暗示了一些保留方法，例如 findById(ID identifier)，这些方法针对域类型标识符属性，而不管其属性名称如何。有关此内容的更多信息，请参阅“定义查询方法"。

items.source: By default, Spring Data inspects the identifier property of the given entity. If the identifier property is null or 0 in case of primitive types, then the entity is assumed to be new. Otherwise, it is assumed to not be new.
items.translation: 默认情况下，Spring Data 会检查给定实体的标识符属性。 如果该标识符属性为 `null`，或者在基本类型情况下为 `0`，则假定该实体是新的。 否则，假定该实体不是新的。

items.source: The central interface in the Spring Data repository abstraction is Repository. It takes the domain class to manage as well as the identifier type of the domain class as type arguments. This interface acts primarily as a marker interface to capture the types to work with and to help you to discover interfaces that extend this one.
items.translation: Spring Data 存储库抽象的核心接口是 Repository。 它接受要管理的领域类以及该领域类的标识符类型作为类型参数。 该接口主要作为一个标记接口，用于捕获需要操作的类型，并帮助您发现扩展此接口的其他接口。

items.source:
Spring Data considers domain types to be entities, more specifically aggregates.
So you will see the term "entity" used throughout the documentation that can be interchanged with the term "domain type" or "aggregate".
items.translation: Spring Data 将领域类型视为实体，更具体地说是聚合。因此，您将在文档中看到“实体”一词被广泛使用，它可以与“领域类型”或“聚合”互换使用。

items.source:
As you might have noticed in the introduction it already hinted towards domain-driven concepts.
We consider domain objects in the sense of DDD.
Domain objects have identifiers (otherwise these would be identity-less value objects), and we somehow need to refer to identifiers when working with certain patterns to access data.
Referring to identifiers will become more meaningful as we talk about repositories and query methods.
items.translation:
正如您在引言中可能已经注意到的，其中已暗示了领域驱动的概念。  
我们按照 DDD 的理念来理解领域对象。  
领域对象具有标识符（否则它们将只是无身份的值对象），而在应用某些模式以访问数据时，我们需要以某种方式引用这些标识符。  
随着我们将讨论仓储和查询方法，引用标识符的意义将变得更加明确。

items.source: In addition to pagination, scrolling provides a more fine-grained access to iterate through chunks of larger result sets.
items.translation: 除了分页之外，滚动提供了更细粒度的访问方式，可用于遍历大型结果集的各个数据块。

items.source: We also provide persistence technology-specific abstractions, such as JpaRepository or MongoRepository. Those interfaces extend CrudRepository and expose the capabilities of the underlying persistence technology in addition to the rather generic persistence technology-agnostic interfaces such as CrudRepository.
items.translation: 我们还提供特定于持久化技术的抽象，例如 JpaRepository 或 MongoRepository》。这些接口扩展了 CrudRepository，除了提供诸如 CrudRepository 等较为通用的、与持久化技术无关的接口之外，还暴露了底层持久化技术的能力。

items.source: Extension interfaces are subject to be supported by the actual store module. While this documentation explains the general scheme, make sure that your store module supports the interfaces that you want to use.
items.translation: 扩展接口需要由实际的商店模块提供支持。 虽然本文档解释了通用方案，但请确保您的商店模块支持您想要使用的接口。
